reference.title: Generate a Token
reference.shortdesc: This section describes the process of generating a token.

section.p: This section describes the process of generating a token.
After creating a key, you must make an API call to obtain a bearer token to access the OtoSense™ APIs.
You can make the API call using the Get Bearer Token method. This method requires the following parameters:

row.entry: The Client ID was displayed when you created the API key in the previous step. For more information, see Create a Client API Key
The Client Secret was displayed when you created the API key in the previous step. For more information, see Create a Client API Key

section.p: The Get Bearer Token response specifies the bearer token’s validity period. You should reuse the bearer token until it is expired, then call Get Bearer Token again to generate a new one.
